title: Exact Noise Limits for Bounded Scalar Stabilization Experiments
summary: How much unknown process noise can a bounded experiment tolerate while still establishing that the plant can be stabilized? We answer this question for scalar discrete-time systems with bounded inputs, exact state measurements, and a disturbance-energy budget proportional to the experiment length. We distinguish individual stabilizability of every consistent model, stabilization by one common gain, and a common quadratic certificate. We determine their exact noise ceilings for every drift.
